biggest_catch: The pay is tiny — at most $60/year — and you earn it by letting Nielsen's software monitor your browsing on your phone and computer continuously; points also expire one year after being credited.
catches: Maximum published reward is $60/year ($30 mobile + $30 computer) — a few dollars a month at best, fully passive.
You must install Nielsen's app/software, which collects browsing and internet-usage data (plus call date/time/duration stats on mobile); this is the entire product — continuous device monitoring.
Points expire 1 year after being credited; accounts inactive on eligible devices for 6 consecutive months are closed and points expire.
Computer-side participation mainly earns entries into the monthly $10,000 sweepstakes, not guaranteed rewards.
Must be 18+ and able to enter a binding contract.
Nielsen states you will never need to provide credit card info or buy anything — free to join.

c1.evidence: The Nielsen Company, LLC — real global measurement company; official panel FAQ hosted at computermobilepanel.nielsen.com (nielsen.com subdomain).

c2.evidence: Official panel FAQ states the concrete terms: 'For installing our app and/or computer software on one or more devices and staying connected, you will receive weekly points redeemable for up to $60 a year in rewards ($30 for mobile; $30 for computer). In addition, for installing our computer software on at least one computer and staying connected each month, you will also be entered into our monthly $10,000 sweepstakes.'

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: 'There is no fee to join this panel. Please note that you will never need to provide credit card information or purchase anything in order to participate.'

c4.evidence: Official Nielsen panel FAQ quote: 'For signing up you will receive opportunities to play scratch-off or spin-the-wheel style games to earn rewards. For installing our app and/or computer software on one or more devices and staying connected, you will receive weekly points redeemable for up to $60 a year in rewards ($30 for mobile; $30 for computer).'

eligibility: Must be at least 18 years old and capable of entering into a binding contract.

steps: Sign up for the Nielsen Computer & Mobile Panel on the official panel site (must be 18+).
Install the Nielsen app on your mobile devices and/or the computer software on your computer(s).
Stay connected and use your devices normally — weekly points are credited automatically.
Redeem accumulated points for rewards (up to $60/year: $30 mobile, $30 computer); points expire 1 year after being credited.
Computer-software members are also entered into the monthly $10,000 sweepstakes each month they stay connected.
